findings.title: Layout-triggering height animation
findings.description: LessonPage.jsx animates height: 'auto' on docs block expansion. Consider using max-height with a fixed value or Framer Motion's layout prop for smoother performance.

findings.title: Layout-triggering width animation
findings.description: Playground.jsx animates width: '100%' on output reveal. Could use scaleX with transform-origin: left instead.

summary: Build passes, animations use transform/opacity primarily, reduced motion handled via useReducedMotion hooks and CSS fallbacks. Two minor layout-triggering animations found but impact is low.
